NOLA King is an upcoming television series starting Samuel L. Jackson. It is a spin-off from television series Tulsa King.
Premise
A career criminal employed by a New York crime family returns to his former city of New Orleans after 40 years away.
Cast
* Samuel L. Jackson as Russell Lee Washington Jr.
Production
The series is written by Dave Erickson who is also executive producer and show runner. It is produced by 101 Studios and MTV Entertainment Studios. Samuel L. Jackson is an executive producer and has a starring role, reportedly reprising the role of Russell Lee Washington Jr. introduced in the third series of Tulsa King. Other executive producers on the series include Taylor Sheridan and 101 Studios' David C. Glasser. Filming is scheduled for February 2026.
